functions.name: FUZZYSCORE
functions.description: Similarity between two names, 0 (nothing alike) to 1 (identical) - ignores case, punctuation, word order and common legal suffixes (Pvt/Ltd/LLC...).

parameters.name: text1
parameters.description: First name or text to compare.

parameters.name: text2
parameters.description: Second name or text to compare.

functions.name: FUZZYLOOKUP
functions.description: Best fuzzy match for a value inside a list. Spills three cells: the matched value, its score (0-1), and the reason it matched. Blank if nothing scores at or above the threshold.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The name or text to look up.

parameters.name: lookupRange
parameters.description: The range of names to search, e.g. B2:B500.

functions.name: DIGITSONLY
functions.description: Keeps only the digit characters in a piece of text - useful for pulling a numeric ID out of a reference that also has letters.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The text to extract digits from.

functions.name: LETTERSONLY
functions.description: Keeps only letter characters (A-Z, a-z) by default, or only the characters you list in keepSet if you supply one.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The text to extract letters from.

parameters.name: keepSet
parameters.description: Optional. A string of characters to keep instead of the default A-Z/a-z, e.g. "aeiouAEIOU" to keep only vowels.

functions.name: NORMALISECHARS
functions.description: Replaces lookalike characters (O/0, I or l/1, S/5, B/8, Z/2) before you compare two IDs - catches a deliberately substituted character that would otherwise pass an exact-match check. Pass your own 2-column From/To range to override the default map.

parameters.name: mapRange
parameters.description: Optional. A 2-column range of From/To character pairs, e.g. your AT Settings character-map table. Uses the built-in default map if omitted.

functions.name: PARSENAME
functions.description: Splits a full name into First / Middle / Last, spilled across three cells. Handles titles (Dr, Mr, Shri...), suffixes (Jr, Sr...) and any number of middle names - not just a fixed two-slot split.

functions.name: BETWEEN
functions.description: Text found between a start marker and the end marker that follows it - handy for pulling a name or ID out of a line formatted like "timestamp - Actor: message".

parameters.name: startDelimiter
parameters.description: The marker to start after, e.g. "-".

parameters.name: endDelimiter
parameters.description: The marker to stop before, e.g. ":".

parameters.name: occurrence
parameters.description: Optional. Which occurrence of startDelimiter to use if it appears more than once (default 1, the first).

functions.name: KEYWORDFLAG
functions.description: Returns which red-flag keyword was found in the text (not just true/false), checked against a built-in default list (cash, personal, adjustment, write-off, advance, urgent) or your own list.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The text to check, e.g. a transaction narration.

parameters.name: keywordRange
parameters.description: Optional. A range of keywords to check against instead of the built-in default list, e.g. your AT Settings keyword table.

functions.name: SMARTDATE
functions.description: Parses a date written in any of several common formats (DD/MM/YYYY, YYYY-MM-DD, "15 June 2026", "June 15, 2026", "15-Jun-26"...) into a real Excel date. Returns blank, never a wrong guess, if the text genuinely cannot be read as a date.
